title: ContactStore::get_changes_since puts all IDs in added[], not distinguishing created vs updated
description: ContactStore::get_changes_since (the simple non-ordered variant) puts all changed contact IDs into the added[] field of ChangesResult, leaving updated[] empty (line 326-330 of contact.rs). The same pattern exists in ChatStore::get_changes_since. These are labeled as 'Phase 1' shortcuts in the doc comments on MessageStore but NOT explicitly labeled on ChatStore or ContactStore's version. Callers in kith-chat that call get_changes_since (as opposed to get_changes_since_ordered) will report all contact and chat changes as 'created' rather than properly partitioned into created[] vs updated[]. This could cause clients to re-create existing objects. The safe surface is get_changes_since_ordered, which correctly computes is_create. The plain get_changes_since variant should either be removed (forcing callers to the ordered form) or clearly deprecated with a doc warning stating that all changes appear in added[] regardless of created/updated classification.
